source_message.text: A previous developer installed Thrive, but it might not be licensed. If that is the case, perhaps we’ll need to remove it.

source_message.text: For page creation, I do use thrive on the current site. However, we built the new site without Thrive, and I can move the landing pages and new pages over to elmentor.

source_message.text:
Removing the page builder now would break the current site because it does more than build pages; its features often control how those pages are styled and displayed. Full removal may therefore have to wait until the new site is ready.

As an interim step, I’ll disable Thrive Apprentice, which is the plugin providing the learning-platform functionality.

ambiguity.description: The freelancer recommends postponing full Thrive removal until the replacement site is ready, but the client has not explicitly confirmed that deferral.

routing_warnings.description: The planned interim disabling of Thrive Apprentice concerns vulnerable-plugin remediation rather than the broader Thrive retention and Elementor migration decision.
